legend: You are given an infinite checkered field. You should get from a square (x1; y1) to a square (x2; y2). Using the shortest path is not necessary. You can move on the field squares in four directions. That is, when you are positioned in any square, you can move to any other side-neighboring one.
A square (x; y) is considered bad, if at least one of the two conditions is fulfilled:
Your task is to find the minimum number of bad cells one will have to visit on the way from (x1; y1) to (x2; y2).
input: The only line contains integers a, b, x1, y1, x2 and y2 — the parameters of the bad squares, the coordinates of the initial and the final squares correspondingly (2 ≤ a, b ≤ 109 and |x1|,|y1|,|x2|,|y2| ≤ 109). It is guaranteed that the initial and the final square aren't bad.
output: Print a single number — the minimum number of bad cells that one will have to visit in order to travel from square (x1; y1) to square (x2; y2).

legend.ai: 给定一个无限的棋盘格。你需要从方格 (x1; y1) 到达方格 (x2; y2)。不必使用最短路径。你可以沿四个方向在棋盘格上移动。也就是说，当你位于任意一个方格时，你可以移动到与其共边相邻的任意另一个方格。
如果以下两个条件中至少一个成立，则称方格 (x; y) 是坏的：
你的任务是求出从 (x1; y1) 到 (x2; y2) 的路上必须经过的坏格子的最少数量。

input.ai: 唯一一行包含整数 a、b、x1、y1、x2 和 y2——坏方格的参数，以及初始方格和最终方格的坐标（2 ≤ a, b ≤ 109 且 |x1|,|y1|,|x2|,|y2| ≤ 109）。保证初始方格和最终方格都不是坏方格。

output.ai: 输出一个数——从方格 (x1; y1) 到方格 (x2; y2) 行进时必须经过的坏格子的最少数量。
